The memo accurately reflects the key financial and transaction terms found in the source document. All major elements are properly supported:

- Transaction parties (Sight Sciences, Inc. as Borrower; MidCap Funding IV Trust as Agent/Lender)
- Amendment effective date (May 10, 2022)
- Original agreement date (November 23, 2020) and prior amendment dates
- Key covenant terms regarding lockbox activation (5 business days prior to initial borrowing)
- Collection and reconciliation requirements (daily basis, 20% threshold for unreconciled amounts)

- Security interest and lien reaffirmations

Where the memo indicates "N/A" for terms like deal size, interest rate, and maturity date, this accurately reflects that these specific terms are not disclosed in this amendment document. The memo appropriately limits itself to information that can be verified from the source material.

- Transaction parties (Sight Sciences, Inc. as Borrower; MidCap Funding IV Trust as Agent/Lender)
- Amendment effective date (May 10, 2022)
- Key operational changes (Lockbox Activation Date definition and procedures)
